theorem backend.fkHalf_rd (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) (rv :
    backend.RView) (h : ∀ (f : Nat) (g : backend.FkG), backend.fkOkG P f g st → backend.fkOkRvG P f
    g rv) : backend.fkHalf γ P st ⊢ backend.fkHalf γ P st ∗ backend.fkRd γ P rv

def backend.batchLockedW (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (st : backend.BSess)
    (win : Bool) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ t db,
      typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"batchTx" b) t DFrac.discard ∗
        sync.ownMutex (backend.muOf t) ∗
          backend.batchPhys γ b t db st ∗ backend.batchGhostW γ P st win ∗ ⌜backend.sessWf P st⌝)

theorem backend.isBackend_bt (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : IProp GF) (b t :
    Loc) : backend.isBackend γ P W Pk b ∗ typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"batchTx" b) t DFrac.discard
    ⊢ ∃ db lg h, typedPointsto (backend.beOf t) b DFrac.discard ∗ typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"lg"
    b) lg DFrac.discard ∗ ⌜lg ≠ null⌝ ∗ typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"batchLimit" b) P.limit
    DFrac.discard ∗ typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"hooks" b) h DFrac.discard ∗ backend.hooksSpec γ P
    Pk b t h ∗ sync.isMutex (backend.muOf t) (backend.batchFree γ P W Pk b t) ∗ backend.isDB db ∗
    ⌜P.Wf⌝

def backend.btW (γ : backend.BNames) (t : Loc) (st : backend.BSess) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(typedPointsto (backend.txFOf t) st.tx (DFrac.own 1) ∗
      typedPointsto (backend.pendOf t) st.pend (DFrac.own 1) ∗ backend.ownWTx st.tx γ.db st.C st.S)

theorem backend.batchLocked_rdB (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (st st' :
    backend.BSess) (s : GoSlice) (v : GoString) : backend.rdB st.tx s v ∗ backend.batchLocked γ P b
    st' ∗ ⌜st'.tx = st.tx⌝ ⊢ ∃ dq, ownSlice s v dq ∗ (ownSlice s v dq -∗ backend.batchLocked γ P b
    st')

theorem backend.batchLocked_rbOwnIn (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (st :
    backend.BSess) (S : GoString → Prop) (r : GMap GoString backend.BktData) : backend.batchLocked γ
    P b st ∗ backend.rbOwnIn γ S r ⊢ backend.batchLocked γ P b st ∗ backend.rbOwnIn γ S r ∗ ⌜∀ (n :
    GoString), S n → backend.rbData P st.S !! n = r !! n⌝

theorem backend.wp_commitsAdd (b : Loc) (v : w64) : ⊢ ∀ Φ, isPkgInit pkg_id.sync.atomic ∗
    backend.metricsInv b -∗ (▷ ∀ n, True -∗ Φ (intoVal n)) -∗ WP (((intoVal (functions
    sync.atomic.AddInt64 [])) (intoVal (backend.bF go!"commits" b))) (intoVal v)) {{ Φ }}

theorem backend.batchLocked_rb (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (st :
    backend.BSess) (r : GMap GoString backend.BktData) : backend.batchLocked γ P b st ∗
    backend.rbOwn γ r ⊢ backend.batchLocked γ P b st ∗ backend.rbOwn γ r ∗ ⌜r = backend.rbData P
    st.S⌝

theorem backend.batchGhostAt_bound (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess)
    (free : Bool) (hP : P.Wf) (hst : backend.sessWf P st) : backend.batchGhostAt γ P st free ⊢ ⌜∀ (i
    : w64), (backend.bkOf st.R.bks i).length + (backend.bkOf st.W.bks i).length < backend.bufBound⌝

    m ≠ bi.name → (st.del bi k).S !! m = st.S !! m

theorem backend.notInterface_int64 : go.NotInterface go.int64

    backend.BSess) : backend.batchLocked γ P b st ⊢ backend.batchLockedW γ P b st false

theorem backend.batchGhost_step (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) {st st' : backend.BSess}
    (hC : st'.C = st.C) (hR : st'.R = st.R) (hc : st'.cnt = st.cnt) (hp : sint.nat st'.pend =
    sint.nat st.pend + 1) (hW : ∀ (i : w64), (backend.bkOf st'.W.bks i).length ≤ (backend.bkOf
    st.W.bks i).length + 1) (hS : backend.hkData P st'.S = backend.hkData P st.S) (hB :
    backend.rbData P st'.S = backend.rbData P st.S) (hF : ∀ (f : Nat) (g : backend.FkG),
    backend.fkOkG P f g st → backend.fkOkG P f g st') : backend.batchGhost γ P st ⊢
    backend.batchGhost γ P st'

def backend.payOut (γ : backend.BNames) (stop : Bool) (m : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  if stop = false ∧ m = 1 then iprop(∃ u', ghostVar γ.used (Qp.half 1) u') else iprop(True)

theorem backend.fkHalf_put (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) {st st' : backend.BSess} (n k
    : GoString) (hF : ¬backend.fkKey n k → ∀ (f : Nat) (g : backend.FkG), backend.fkOkG P f g st →
    backend.fkOkG P f g st') (hR : backend.fkKey n k → ∀ (f : Nat) (g : backend.FkG), backend.fkOkG
    P f g st → backend.fkOkG P (f + 1) g st') : ⊢ backend.fkHalf γ P st -∗ backend.fkPut γ n k ==∗
    backend.fkHalf γ P st' ∗ backend.fkPut γ n k

theorem backend.opn_stop (γ : backend.BNames) : ⊢ dghostVar γ.opn (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1).half) false
    -∗ dghostVar γ.opn (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1).half) false -∗ dghostVar γ.opn (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1))
    false ==∗ backend.bStopped γ

theorem backend.rbData_other (P : backend.BParams) {S S' : backend.Data} {n : GoString} (h : ∀ (m :
    GoString), m ≠ n → S' !! m = S !! m) (m : GoString) : m ≠ n → backend.rbData P S' !! m =
    backend.rbData P S !! m

theorem backend.batchGhost_step_put (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) {st st' :
    backend.BSess} (hC : st'.C = st.C) (hR : st'.R = st.R) (hc : st'.cnt = st.cnt) (hp : sint.nat
    st'.pend = sint.nat st.pend + 1) (hW : ∀ (i : w64), (backend.bkOf st'.W.bks i).length ≤
    (backend.bkOf st.W.bks i).length + 1) (n k : GoString) (hS : P.hk n k = false → backend.hkData P
    st'.S = backend.hkData P st.S) (hB : P.RB n = false → backend.rbData P st'.S = backend.rbData P
    st.S) (hF : ¬backend.fkKey n k → ∀ (f : Nat) (g : backend.FkG), backend.fkOkG P f g st →
    backend.fkOkG P f g st') (hFk : backend.fkKey n k → ∀ (f : Nat) (g : backend.FkG), backend.fkOkG
    P f g st → backend.fkOkG P (f + 1) g st') (hBT : P.RB n = true → ∃ i, P.BT !! n = some i) (hO :
    ∀ (m : GoString), m ≠ n → st'.S !! m = st.S !! m) : ⊢ backend.batchGhost γ P st -∗ backend.hkPut
    γ P n k st.S -∗ backend.rbPut γ P n st.S -∗ backend.fkPut γ n k ==∗ backend.batchGhost γ P st' ∗
    backend.hkPut γ P n k st'.S ∗ backend.rbPut γ P n st'.S ∗ backend.fkPut γ n k

theorem backend.fk_halves (γ : backend.BNames) (n : Nat) : monoNatAuthOwn γ.fk 1 n ⊣⊢ monoNatAuthOwn
    γ.fk (Qp.half 1) n ∗ monoNatAuthOwn γ.fk (Qp.half 1) n

theorem backend.batchGhost_step_rb (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) {st st' :
    backend.BSess} (hC : st'.C = st.C) (hR : st'.R = st.R) (hc : st'.cnt = st.cnt) (hp : sint.nat
    st'.pend = sint.nat st.pend + 1) (hW : ∀ (i : w64), (backend.bkOf st'.W.bks i).length ≤
    (backend.bkOf st.W.bks i).length + 1) (n : GoString) (hS : backend.hkData P st'.S =
    backend.hkData P st.S) (hB : P.RB n = false → backend.rbData P st'.S = backend.rbData P st.S)
    (hF : ∀ (f : Nat) (g : backend.FkG), backend.fkOkG P f g st → backend.fkOkG P f g st') (hBT :
    P.RB n = true → ∃ i, P.BT !! n = some i) (hO : ∀ (m : GoString), m ≠ n → st'.S !! m = st.S !! m)
    : ⊢ backend.batchGhost γ P st -∗ backend.rbPut γ P n st.S ==∗ backend.batchGhost γ P st' ∗
    backend.rbPut γ P n st'.S

theorem backend.rdB_acc (tx : Loc) (s : GoSlice) (v : GoString) (q : Qp) : backend.rdB tx s v ∗
    backend.txLive tx q ⊢ ∃ dq, ownSlice s v dq ∗ (ownSlice s v dq -∗ backend.txLive tx q)

    (seq : Bool) (m : GoString) : m ≠ bi.name → (st.put bi k v seq).S !! m = st.S !! m

theorem backend.batchGhostAt_take (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) :
    backend.batchGhostAt γ P st true ⊢ backend.batchGhost γ P st

theorem backend.batchLocked_hk (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (st :
    backend.BSess) (d : GMap (GoString × GoString) GoString) : backend.batchLocked γ P b st ∗
    backend.hkOwn γ d ⊢ backend.batchLocked γ P b st ∗ backend.hkOwn γ d ∗ ⌜d = backend.hkData P
    st.S⌝

def backend.batchGhostW (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) (win : Bool)
    : IProp GF :=
  iprop(backend.batchViewQ γ P st ∗
      ∃ n w u,
        ghostVar γ.rvs (Qp.half 1) ((st.C, st.R), win) ∗
          ownTokAuth γ.wb n ∗
            monoNatAuthOwn γ.wbc 1 w ∗
              ghostVar γ.used (Qp.half 1) u ∗
                dghostVar γ.opn (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1).half) false ∗
                  backend.trkHalf γ P st.S ∗ backend.fkHalf γ P st ∗ ⌜backend.bgOk P st false n w u⌝)

theorem backend.batchGhostAt_p0 (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) :
    backend.batchGhostAt γ P st true ⊢ ⌜st.cnt.p0 = sint.nat st.pend⌝

theorem backend.BSess.delBucket_S_other (st : backend.BSess) (bi : backend.BucketInfo) (m :
    GoString) : m ≠ bi.name → (st.delBucket bi).S !! m = st.S !! m

theorem backend.isBackend_b (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : IProp GF) (b : Loc) :
    backend.isBackend γ P W Pk b ⊢ ∃ t rt db lg, typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"batchTx" b) t
    DFrac.discard ∗ typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"readTx" b) rt DFrac.discard ∗ typedPointsto
    (backend.bF go!"lg" b) lg DFrac.discard ∗ ⌜lg ≠ null⌝ ∗ backend.metricsInv b ∗ typedPointsto
    (backend.beOf t) b DFrac.discard ∗ sync.isMutex (backend.muOf t) (backend.batchFree γ P W Pk b
    t) ∗ sync.isRWMutexGuard (backend.rmuOf (backend.baseOf rt)) (backend.rtRes γ P rt) ∗
    (sync.isRWMutexGuard (backend.bF go!"mu" b) fun q => typedPointsto (backend.bF go!"db" b) db
    (DFrac.own q)) ∗ backend.isDB db ∗ backend.cacheInv γ ∗ ⌜P.Wf⌝

theorem backend.wp_metricStore (b : Loc) (f : GoString) (v : w64) (hf : f = go!"size" ∨ f =
    go!"sizeInUse" ∨ f = go!"commits" ∨ f = go!"openReadTxN") : ⊢ ∀ Φ, isPkgInit pkg_id.sync.atomic
    ∗ backend.metricsInv b -∗ ▷ (True -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗ WP (((intoVal (functions
    sync.atomic.StoreInt64 [])) (intoVal (backend.bF f b))) (intoVal v)) {{ Φ }}

theorem backend.batchLocked_rbPart (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (st :
    backend.BSess) (S : GoString → Prop) (r : GMap GoString backend.BktData) : backend.batchLocked γ
    P b st ∗ backend.rbPart γ S r ⊢ backend.batchLocked γ P b st ∗ backend.rbPart γ S r ∗ ⌜∀ (n :
    GoString), S n → backend.rbData P st.S !! n = r !! n⌝

theorem backend.batchLocked_rdB2 (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) (st st' :
    backend.BSess) (s1 s2 : GoSlice) (v1 v2 : GoString) : backend.rdB st.tx s1 v1 ∗ backend.rdB
    st.tx s2 v2 ∗ backend.batchLocked γ P b st' ∗ ⌜st'.tx = st.tx⌝ ⊢ ∃ dq1 dq2, ownSlice s1 v1 dq1 ∗
    ownSlice s2 v2 dq2 ∗ (ownSlice s1 v1 dq1 -∗ ownSlice s2 v2 dq2 -∗ backend.batchLocked γ P b st')

theorem backend.BSess.create_S_other (st : backend.BSess) (bi : backend.BucketInfo) (m : GoString) :
    m ≠ bi.name → (st.create bi).S !! m = st.S !! m

theorem backend.fkHalf_mono (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) {st st' : backend.BSess} (hF
    : ∀ (f : Nat) (g : backend.FkG), backend.fkOkG P f g st → backend.fkOkG P f g st') :
    backend.fkHalf γ P st ⊢ backend.fkHalf γ P st'

theorem backend.fkHalf_raise (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (st st' : backend.BSess) (g
    : Nat) (hR : ∀ (f : Nat) (g : backend.FkG), backend.fkOkG P f g st → backend.fkOkG P (f + 1) g
    st') : ⊢ backend.fkHalf γ P st -∗ backend.fkOwn γ g ==∗ backend.fkHalf γ P st' ∗ ∃ g',
    backend.fkOwn γ g'
